description: A serene private head beneath its own small skylight: pale plaster, warm oak, a walk-in shower open to the falling light. A soft-edged basin, a concealed toilet, a fogged pane that carries the weather. The door seals with a soft magnetic sigh.

window.description: A window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window
